title: hieracium involutiforme
intro: Hieracium involutiforme, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, digestive problems, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium involutiforme include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
